mapper.select: SELECT r.province, r.region, r.city, r.aqi, r.pm25, r.pm10, r.quality_level AS qualityLevel, r.monitor_time AS monitorTime, CASE WHEN r.aqi >= 150 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS warning FROM air_quality_record r INNER JOIN ( SELECT city, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM ( SELECT id, city, monitor_time FROM air_quality_record WHERE (city, monitor_time) IN ( SELECT city, MAX(monitor_time) FROM air_quality_record WHERE city NOT LIKE '%-%' GROUP BY city ) ) latest_time_rows GROUP BY city ) latest ON latest.latest_id = r.id WHERE r.city NOT LIKE '%-%' ORDER BY r.aqi DESC

SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(aqi), 1) AS avgAqi, ROUND(AVG(pm25), 1) AS avgPm25, ROUND(AVG(pm10), 1) AS avgPm10, COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS cityCount, SUM(CASE WHEN aqi <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCityCount, SUM(CASE WHEN aqi > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pollutedCityCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN aqi <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS goodRate, SUM(CASE WHEN aqi >= 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningCount FROM ( SELECT r.* FROM air_quality_record r INNER JOIN ( SELECT city, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM ( SELECT id, city, monitor_time FROM air_quality_record WHERE (city, monitor_time) IN ( SELECT city, MAX(monitor_time) FROM air_quality_record WHERE city NOT LIKE '%-%' GROUP BY city ) ) latest_time_rows GROUP BY city ) latest ON latest.latest_id = r.id WHERE r.city NOT LIKE '%-%' ) latest_record GROUP BY region ORDER BY avgAqi DESC
